affected.note: Up to about 200,000 records of customers who were sent direct mail from March 2018 to November 2023. The attack was confirmed on 2023-12-13; disclosed_on is the first news report found (the company's own notice date was not confirmed).

summary.en: Fishing tackle retailer Ofuji Tsurigu was hit by a ransomware attack confirmed on 2023-12-13. Up to about 200,000 records of customers who received its direct mail, including names, addresses, phone numbers and birthdates, may have leaked.
summary.ja: 釣り具販売の大藤つり具は、2023年12月13日にランサムウェア攻撃を受けたことを確認した。同社からダイレクトメールを送付した顧客の氏名、住所、電話番号、生年月日など最大約20万件が流出した可能性がある。

sources.title: ランサム被害、顧客情報20万件が流出か - 大藤つり具
